description: This PHP source file defines the PurgeDao class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system, specifically in the Maintenance plugin. The class provides methods for querying employee data related to purging operations, such as checking if an employee is purgeable and extracting data based on employee number.

methods.name: isEmployeePurgeable
